svg.title: A conditional finite-size model suppresses splitting

cc:Work.dc:title: A conditional finite-size model suppresses splitting
cc:Work.dc:description: The exponential is an illustrative finite-size model; real systems can include oscillations and other terms. Reduced splitting alone does not establish protected operations or suppress nonequilibrium parity changes.
